BWA.note: No rule or authority on AI harms is stated.
No government body's use of AI is stated; the developers call for government support.
Health and education are named only as possible uses; no public sector system uses it.

facts.fact: Guardian Sun reports that two Batswana, Kitso Speaks and Glen Mokoka, built a Setswana AI trained on a self-collected dataset of books, newspapers and recorded conversations, self-funded, with mobile apps and dialects still in development.
